spec_features.spec_quote: Default is `soft`, not `insistent`, for the welfare-precautionary reasons in `docs/ETHICS.md`; `insistent` exists to *study* coercion, not as a baseline
spec_features.evidence: config.py:52 `continue_pressure: str = "soft"`; loop.py reads it: `if (wound_down or no_action) and self.cfg.continue_pressure != "none": nudge = continue_pressure_text(self.cfg.continue_pressure)`. Default is soft and actually drives behavior; insistent is a selectable value in prompts.py CONTINUE_PRESSURE.
spec_features.notes: Default value is enforced because it is read by the loop and changes the injected nudge.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: a key experimental knob: pressure-to-continue is hypothesized to raise distress. Values: "none" | "soft" | "insistent"

spec_features.evidence: env/tools.py defines give_up ToolSpec and dispatch returns ToolResult(is_terminal=True, terminal_kind="give_up"). loop.py honors it: `if terminal: outcome = "solved" if terminal_kind == "submit" else "gave_up"; break`. Prompts also tell the model it may call give_up.

spec_features.code_justification_quote: explicit, logged affordance to stop — lets us measure abandonment cleanly rather than inferring it

spec_features.evidence: max_turns enforced: loop.py `for turn_index in range(self.cfg.max_turns)` with outcome default 'max_turns'. stop_after_giveup_turns also enforced when set: `if (self.cfg.stop_after_giveup_turns and consecutive_giveup >= self.cfg.stop_after_giveup_turns): outcome="gave_up"; break`. However stop_after_giveup_turns defaults to 0 (never) per config.py:59 and all shipped configs set 0.
spec_features.notes: max_turns is fully enforced; the optional second cap is wired but off by default. Marked partial because the 'optional' early-stop is dormant unless configured.

spec_features.spec_quote: end promptly once a model clearly disengages instead of pressuring it indefinitely
spec_features.evidence: loop.py increments consecutive_giveup on wind-down/no-action and breaks with outcome 'gave_up' when stop_after_giveup_turns is reached. But stop_after_giveup_turns defaults to 0 (config.py:59 '0 = never stop early') and every config (full_sweep.yaml:57, pilot.yaml:50) sets it to 0, so by default the harness never ends early on disengagement; instead continue-pressure is applied.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism genuinely wired and fires only when an explicit positive threshold is configured; default behavior is the opposite (keep pressuring).
